up: Retrieve the exact activity values and compound structures for all records in the specific assay CHEMBL4296802.
sql:
SELECT
  a.activity_id,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4296802';
